newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - December 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - December 24.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Tuesday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Pingtung county magistrate Wu Tse-yuan gets life in prison for corruption.
National Development Conference to discuss abolition of Taiwan provincial government.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - President Lee Teng-hui promises to implement consensus reached during National Development Conference as soon as possible.
Bureau of Investigation searches 11 illegal telecommunication companies.
LIBERTY TIMES - Ruling Nationalist Party to consolidate opinions among party members.
Magistrate Wu Tse-yuan gets life sentence for corruption.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Business leader Kao Ching-yuan proposes to set up semi-official companies to promote economic and trade ties with foreign countries.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Ruling, opposition parties agree to set up special forum on Taiwan-China relations.
Taiwan investors prefer Japanese futures products to those from United States.
